command: docker exec acs-a7-qa-redis-1 sh -c 'for k in $(redis-cli -n 0 --scan --pattern "chat:*:active"); do echo "$k $(redis-cli -n 0 zcard $k)"; done; echo conversation-locks: $(redis-cli -n 0 --scan --pattern "chat:*:conversation:*" | wc -l)'; docker exec acs-a7-qa-postgres-1 sh -c 'psql -U $POSTGRES_USER -d $POSTGRES_DB -tAc "select state, count(*) from pg_stat_activity where datname=current_database() group by 1"'
